name: Gradient-Based SE(3) Optimization
definition: A gradient-descent optimization process to refine the transformation $\hat{T}$ between Scene A and Scene B by minimizing photometric loss on rays sampled from high viewshed score regions.
summary: Gradient-Based SE(3) Optimization rigidly aligns radiance fields by minimizing photometric error across multiple novel views, using viewshed masks to restrict sampling to high-confidence regions and avoid NeRF artifacts.
